summary: Round 6 is the most structurally disciplined build yet — all five Tier A gates pass, the type ramp is locked at the CSS level, and the copy could only be Pip — but the keepsake hands the user their own two sentences back verbatim and reprints them on the same screen, and the calm screen makes its exit button the loudest object, sets its heading in the memory serif and talks over a screen reader every four seconds: council total 86.0 with 10 verified red flags.
